witheraway.configuration.disableWitherBo: If enabled, the purple boss bar at the top of the screen will not be shown for Withers.
witheraway.configuration.disableWitherDa: If enabled, the sky and screen will not darken when a Wither is nearby.
witheraway.configuration.muteWitherSpawn: Mutes the world-wide sound played when a Wither is summoned.
witheraway.configuration.muteAllOtherWit: Mutes ambient, hurt, and death sounds, as well as all Wither-specific explosions (including the spawn explosion and skull impacts).
